question:
A set of numbers \(S\) is said to be multiplicatively closed if \(ab\in S\) whenever both \(a\in S\) and \(b\in S\). Let \(i=\sqrt{-1}\) and \(\omega\) be a non-real cube root of unity. Let
\[
S_1=\{a+bi\mid a,b\text{ are integers}\}\quad\text{and}\quad S_2=\{a+b\omega\mid a,b\text{ are integers}\}.
\]
Which one of the following statements is true?

options.B: \(S_1\) is multiplicatively closed but \(S_2\) is not.
options.C: \(S_2\) is multiplicatively closed but \(S_1\) is not.
